maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 01 · The Mercy Is Not Missing

nodeData.topic: Session 01 · The Mercy Is Not Missing
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Opening the Kartik series on the book Radha Sunya, Maharaj explains that Krishna's mercy is always available; what is missing is our appetite for it, and offences (apa-radha, being without Radha) are what deprive us. He stresses the power of a genuine 'sorry', service to Vaishnavas, and going inward through contemplation, and closes with forgiveness and a daily journal exercise. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj welcomes everyone to the yearly Kartik programme and compares Krishna consciousness to a feast: how much we take depends on how hungry we are.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:15 (auto-transcript): “We are very, very, very happy to have all of you attending this program, which we are doing every year, during the month of Catholic. We have done the government last year. It was very sweet. We went through the whole Brandavan the whole Brandavan and then we devoted”

Brazilians and the French wish each other a good appetite before eating. Devotees especially need a good spiritual appetite; without it we take very little.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:50 (auto-transcript): “Similarly, it is the same in Christian consciousness. Those who have good appetite, I've seen in Brazil and in French country, they have a very good approach towards eating. In English, we don't have good supplements towards eating. But South Americans, French people, they…”

children.topic: Lazy for Krishna, active for the body
children.note:
Many devotees show little appetite: lazy for japa, for hearing and for Krishna's work, yet energetic for whatever concerns the body and mind. Krishna consciousness lets each of us see where we stand individually. — “We are lazy for hearing about Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:10 (auto-transcript): “If we don't have a good appetite, we will not eat much. We have seen that with many devotees who are not attracted to Krishna consciousness. means our spiritual appetite is not strong. We are lazy for japa. We are lazy for hearing about Krishna. We are lazy for activities…”

Prasadam of every variety is ready around the clock — books of the acharyas, seminars, festivals, Kartik and Ekadasi celebrations, devotees ready to serve. Like a trader whose goods are too heavy to carry home, the acharyas will give to anyone with even a little appetite. — “Only the hungry customers are scarce.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:22 (auto-transcript): “A prasadam is available all the time. So Krishna and our chariots, they have made the prasadum available. Varieties of prasadum are available in Krishna consciousness. So scarcity. 24 hours, the prasadums are ready. The sabbaths are ready. Only the hungry customers are…”

Maharaj recalls Jesus' parable: the sower throws the seed of God's message; some falls on water or rock and only a little on fertile soil, where it grows and multiplies. Our fortune is to support this sowing, and we pray that the seed falls on good soil.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:14 (auto-transcript): “the appetite is missing so like jesus like jesus the christ jesus said behold the seed sower the seed sower the seed sower the seed is message of godhead the sower is the preacher the sound of christina jesus is lamenting the seed sower going going to the field We are in the…”

'Missing mercy' does not mean the mercy is absent; it means we are depriving ourselves of it. The series asks what we are doing that causes this. — “missing mercy means that we are depriving ourselves of this mercy”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:00 (auto-transcript): “Yes, Radha Sunya, missing mercy. Please don't forget, we said this, the mercy is not missing. missing mercy means that we are depriving ourselves of this mercy and what is what are we doing that is depriving us of that mercy is his holiness but samaraz will explain it so…”

Maharaj reads from the front of the book: as Jiva Gosvami begins his work by offering respects to the Lord, the devotees and the acharyas, and then a testimony of a family who came to a Vyasa-puja festival in a snowstorm and felt sheltered by Bhakti Tirtha Swami's love.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:04 (auto-transcript): “the merciful guide his holiness is explaining sheltered by love we are sheltered by love this is how acharyas the head. Shalajiva Goswami heard the Gopala Champo. And he begins his book. Respect to the Supreme”

Heaters, jackets and tea are material; they cannot melt the snow of maya that has frozen us in this world. Only the pure devotee's love can.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:32 (auto-transcript): “can pull for feet it can we also warmer that's called cloth before you put jacket and tea it's a material we have a heater we have a heater to heat it on warmer all is a material this cannot melt the snow of Maya your love is the only means to melt the snow of Maya that you…”

children.topic: A warm reception from the heart
children.note:
Being received in a sitting room with no room, bathroom, water or prasadam sends a message to leave; a plastic smile is external. A heart that truly welcomes you is worth more than gold or medicine, even with nothing material to give. — “that heart is more than gold”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:45 (auto-transcript): “That means the way they were received that is one the way they were received it was welcoming if you see somebody and receiving you in the sitting room and not showing you which room you are going to stay no bathroom no prasadam no water nothing that will not that is a…”

The testimony tells of Bhakti Tirtha Swami dancing in ecstasy on his one remaining leg. What is inside comes out; pure devotees show the power of association through love in action, not words. The family's faith deepened and a daughter took up sixteen rounds. — “that's what is happening when you love somebody”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:24 (auto-transcript): “dancing with one leg what was inside when manifest outside that's what is happening when you love somebody right by embracing, by kissing that is what is the expression expression of the love you have of somebody it comes out in that way embracing and kissing hugging and…”

children.topic: Why this series: to be groomed
children.note:
The series reflects on Radha Sunya by Bhakti Tirtha Swami, whose aim is to understand aparadha and experience mercy gained and mercy shared; the book also shows how to remove obstacles to devotion.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:56 (auto-transcript): “Radha Sunya, Missing Mercy. This series is based on reflections on the sacred teachings. Father Sunya by His Holiness Dr. Tita Maharaj. The goal is to understand aparad and experience mercy gained and mercy shawed. Mercy gained and mercy shawed. This is the reason for…”

Krishna consciousness is not merely a list of prohibitions. We first have to be refined and moulded as human beings to practise it. — “It's not just about don't.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:01 (auto-transcript): “He has mentioned many times that Krishna consciousness is not about rules. Don't do this. Don't, don't, don't, don't. It's not just about don't. don't don't it is this is not christian consciousness but we have to be made a human being to practice christian consciousness so…”

A singer trains the voice with exercises and warm water so that people want to hear; likewise the ear must be trained to hear sound and respond nicely. Maharaj says his own experience of reading, hearing and being trained by Bhakti Tirtha Swami is that his books groom devotees for a positive attitude.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:47 (auto-transcript): “In music, we say groom the voice. you have to groom the voice you will do some exercise that's how you groom the voice train the voice you don't drink hot water you don't drink cold water you drink all day warm water especially in the morning you don't do anything you…”

The editor explains the title: apa-radha joins 'apa' — without, given up — and 'Radha'. No Srimati Radharani means no Krishna; offences make us feel her withdrawal from our lives.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:12 (auto-transcript): “Onasani Radha Sunia, the title deep meaning missing, missing, missing, missing, missing, missing, missing, from the editor's explanation, Radha Sunia, Aparada, according to the voice of a Mexican, means devoid of Radharani. APA RADA that two words”

Maharaj recognises a pure devotee by how careful he is not to offend. We are ready to commit any offence; some devotees are chronic offenders. — “Fools, they rush where angels fear to tread.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:29 (auto-transcript): “And from my practical experience, one of the ways I understood who is a pure devotee is a very, very careful making sense. There is a saying, fools rush where angels fear to tread. Fools, they rush where angels fear to tread. means what? We are ready to commit”

It is very risky to remain a neophyte, who can offend anyone, especially Vaishnavas in this age. The intermediate stage is safer, so we should try to rise to it. — “We should try to raise ourselves to Madhya.”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:40 (auto-transcript): “So we have been mentioning many times that it is very, very dangerous to remain a neophyte devotee. We should try to raise ourselves to Madhya. Madhya is safe. For Madhya, we can go to... We should try. Very, very risky to remain in Afghanistan. because we can make any…”

children.topic: The devotee who wanted to leave
children.note:
A devotee listed to Maharaj all the devotees he could not bear and planned to return to his village. Maharaj heard him out, then told him the truth: his offences were driving him away. He had no temple or devotees to go to, so Maharaj begged him to stay and respect the devotees; he stayed and still chants.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:40 (auto-transcript): “The experience will begin to experience a void created by had a mobile and we suffer. One devotee, when they were telling me, Maharaj, I just want to leave this temple. This devotee, this devotee, this devotee, this devotee. I just want to leave these devotees. I don't want…”

Not the GBC, the guru, the spouse, the godbrothers or the project manager: nothing but our offences can take us away from devotional life. — “none of them is our problem we are our own problems”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:52 (auto-transcript): “not used me to do some service for him but rather it's the only thing that can throw us away from nothing else can stop us from that oh my gbc oh my guru oh my wife my husband my god brothers my god sisters my commander my project manager my this my this my this my this they…”

Becoming agitated, easily angered, dry in devotion and lazy, with japa dragging on, are warning signs of offences. A fortunate devotee notices this and begins to hanker more intensely for Radharani's presence, the start of rectification. — “This is a sign of danger.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:16 (auto-transcript): “Devotives were very fortunate. We started to see that, oh, I'm becoming more agitated. I'm becoming easily angered. I'm becoming very dry in my Christian consciousness. My job is dragging on and on and on. I'm getting very lazy now doing something. This is a sign. This is a…”

Radharani embodies Krishna's mercy; she is ever present, but may withdraw so that her absence is felt. Krishna's compassion comes from her.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:10 (auto-transcript): “What is the reality? That only represents Krishna's compassionate side or merciful side. So when we are devoid of Radharani, we are missing, feeling the absence of our mercy. In reality, Radharani is ever-present, remember. But she may withdraw from us so that our presence is…”

A man whose wife, named Kishori, had left him came to Vrindavan crying for her. Radharani heard the name and, though told he was only calling his wife, had him brought to her, and he was blessed. Maharaj adds that a meaningful name given in India is a fortune.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:56 (auto-transcript): “I had a pastime of a man who lost his wife. His wife, he was doing something. I think the wife left him. And because he was very attached to his wife, he came to Glandava. Unfortunately for him, His wife's name is Kishori, it's a beauty of being born in India, to have a big…”

If an ordinary man calling an ordinary Kishori received such mercy, what if we call the original Kishori? We should not cheapen her name, but Maharaj warns against extremes that forbid calling Radha in the name of purity. — “I should call Radha, Radha.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:31 (auto-transcript): “So if he can cry for ordinary woman and get the message material that they need, what about us if he called Kishori original Kishori? What would happen to us if we call original Kishori? If a colony can call Kishori and get the message material that he's missing, Why I should…”

children.topic: The power of a genuine sorry
children.note:
We all offend, very easily, and Vaishnavas most easily of all. Few are fortunate enough to recognise their mistakes; many never accept them even when told.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:04 (auto-transcript): “with regard to offenses as we know we all make the offenses yes yes yes very easy the easiest offense we make every day is what vice versa and that is the first one we would mention where's my father very easily as you know we we all make offenses especially in we are…”

Maharaj has seen devotees who have never said sorry to anyone in their whole life. A Vaishnava's heart melts, he claims no rights, and he is humble; if my 'purity' offends someone, I am no longer pure.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:47 (auto-transcript): “organized even if we are told we would never accept I've seen so many devotees like this in their life they have never say sorry to anybody in that in their life as a whole life they have never won the third one somebody i'm sorry they have not they have never told anybody…”

A genuine sorry purifies us. It is only one word and takes a second, yet its absence has destroyed marriages, friendships and relationships at work. — “It's not ordinary to say sorry.”

🎙 Maharaj at 74:35 (auto-transcript): “and the moment you genuinely say sorry, you'll get purified that genuine sorry will make you get purified because it has potency. That is why many people are not fortunate to have sorry in their mood. It's not ordinary to say sorry. It's just a one word, sorry. But this…”

As the desire to serve Vaishnavas grows, Krishna lets it cancel the effects of our offences and uproot the offensive mentality. Maharaj names three potent ornaments: service to Vaishnavas, compassion for all souls, and taste for the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:50 (auto-transcript): “As we increasingly desire to serve the Vaisnavas better, Krishna will allow this desire to be the servant of the servant, to cancel out the negative effects of our offenses. Vaisnavas server does what? Cancel our offensive mentality. Service to Vaisnavas. will counsel, uproot…”

Taste for the name follows freedom from offences. Maharaj recalls Bhaktivinoda Thakura's prayer for the day tears will flow and the voice choke while chanting, which comes as we strive to be servants of the servants.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:16 (auto-transcript): “Hari Nama Guthi. Aparada Guthi. Namruti. Aparada Guthi. Nam, Gucci, Bhaktivinoda Takura. Oh, when will I turn their holy name and tears will come from my heart, from my eyes. My throat will choke. Gah, gah, gah, gah. Bhaktivinoda Takura, say. Bhaktivinoda Takura. Apparat,…”

Maharaj asks the class what contemplation is and why it brings realization, and invites answers. — “No contemplation, no realization.”

🎙 Maharaj at 78:31 (auto-transcript): “We should go inside, through reflections. We have mentioned many times. Without contemplation, no realization. No contemplation, no realization. What is contemplation? And why is it bringing realization? What is contemplation? What do you mean by contemplation? What is it?…”

A devotee answers that deep reflection lets the Supersoul give intelligence. Maharaj agrees: going inside means communicating with the Supersoul, and the realization is his gift, not our own potency.

🎙 Maharaj at 81:34 (auto-transcript): “blessing. That's why we get some realization. Thank you very much. Thank you. The reflection contemplation means communication with super soul is a super soul who gives you realization yes it's not just something what is a something that's a super soul you may not see the…”

children.topic: There but for the grace of God
children.note:
Before pointing fingers at others, look at yourself; whatever good we have is Krishna's mercy, and we should see others with that eye.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:34 (auto-transcript): “before pointing figure fingers at others take a good look at yourself and remember there but for the grace of God go I I repeat before pointing fingers at others we should take a good look at ourselves and remember there there but for the grace of God go I it is the mercy of…”

children.topic: Sorry as a sign of advancement
children.note:
Devotees ask how to know they are advancing. One sign: readiness to say sorry. Fasting, sleeping on the floor or bathing daily in the Yamuna mean nothing if they do not soften the heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 83:46 (auto-transcript): “many times devotees always ask how do I know I'm making an advancement there's so many ways to know at present moment when a devotee is ready to say sorry you're making an advancement when he cannot say sorry you're not making an advancement if you like preserve without…”

For a few minutes: think of a devotee whose behaviour you have criticised; can you find the same tendency in yourself? How would a pure devotee handle it? Would compassion change your criticism? One who cannot say sorry never sees in himself what he sees in others. — “This is heart surgery for those of us who want to be doing it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 87:13 (auto-transcript): “how do you think a pure devotee will deal with this situation this is powerful workshop this is heart surgery they write it down and think about this this look into this one can you find similar tendencies you criticize and others within yourself as well yes no take away…”

The spiritual world we are aiming for is governed by respect, compassion, forgiveness and pure love.

🎙 Maharaj at 89:31 (auto-transcript): “The spiritual world's governing principle. The spiritual world's governing principle. What we are looking toward. What are we looking toward? The spiritual world is a place governed by respect, compassion, forgiveness, and love. The spiritual world is a place governed by…”

The two leaders of the gopis are described as sisters who quarrel, but all their quarrels are for Krishna's pleasure. Maharaj warns that this is beyond ordinary standards and not to be judged as offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 90:14 (auto-transcript): “the other day when we look at Krishna Krishna has right wing gopis and the left wing gopis the left wing and the right wing headed by Samati Radarani and Samati Chandravali Chandravali is who? Chandravali chandravalli is who right it will be forgotten chandravalli is who…”

children.topic: Care for the devotee beside you
children.note:
At a house programme in Houston a devotee spoke deeply about going back to Godhead. Maharaj laughed: how can we talk of the spiritual world when we don't even care for the devotee sitting next to us?

🎙 Maharaj at 95:29 (auto-transcript): “pure. That is what it matters. When I was in the U.S., there was a discussion. His greatest Harry Paschal, he was speaking. And then in Houston, one devotee of this house program, waiting me to attend. So I went there. Anyway, Prabhu was giving a nice discussion. So a nice…”

We must consciously release those who offended us from blame. Keeping a grudge is like holding fire: the offender may have forgotten, but the one who carries it keeps burning. — “who feels happy holding fire”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:22 (auto-transcript): “joking our current challenge if we are holding grudges seeing others as non-vistarers that mentality will create problems we must consciously release those who have offended us from blame we must consciously release free those who have offended us from blame”

If we do not forgive, nobody will forgive us. What is so special about me that I should be forgiven while I cannot forgive others?

🎙 Maharaj at 99:36 (auto-transcript): “If we don't forgive, nobody will forgive us. What is so important in me that I should be forgiven and I cannot forgive you? What is so important, so special in you, that you should be forgiven, but you cannot forgive others? What is this? It's all useless. All right? Don't…”

Keep a small notebook and journal for fifteen minutes: three devotees who recently showed you mercy and how; one offence you may have committed or are prone to; and a written prayer to your spiritual master and Radharani to help you recognise and avoid offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 100:17 (auto-transcript): “realization through contemplation. Keep a small notebook for this daily practice. Throw out our critique. We shall do what? We shall do what? Keep a notebook. Throw out. This is our discussion. A reflection. Today, spend 15 minutes in journaling the following journal. Write.…”

nodeData.topic: Session 02 · Aparadha, Devoid of Radha
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj teaches that bhakti requires knowing what to accept and what to reject, and defines aparadha as becoming devoid of Radharani, the overseer of devotion. Progress in this age comes by mercy, received through humility, respect for all and the dust of the devotees' feet, as Brahma showed after his offence. In the questions he explains how to recognise and rectify offences we are unaware of, why to serve without expecting results, and how to keep practising even when prayer feels mechanical. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: What to accept, what to reject
children.note:
Success in anything needs evaluation and accountability; so does devotion. Pure Krishna consciousness is immeasurable, but practitioners should measure the quality of their practice, as a traveller who knows the distance knows what speed to keep.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:48 (auto-transcript): “A parada. So, what is to be accepted, and what are the things that should be rejected? Materially speaking, if we won't want to be successful in anything, there should be evaluation. Similarly, in vocational consciousness, there should be evaluation, accountability. as you…”

We do not eat every food; we choose what suits our body. People drink many liquids, yet no one drinks petrol. Intelligence means discriminating what helps devotion and what harms it. — “but nobody drinks gasoline it's also a liquid”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:18 (auto-transcript): “foods you're not going to eat everything i have to sell it the food that is suitable for our system and i reject the food that is not suitable many people are drinking so many things in this material but nobody drinks gasoline it's also a liquid no but nobody drinks it so it…”

Stand still in a busy crowd and you are pushed from every side. Prabhupada called it a movement: every devotee must move forward, or he becomes a problem for himself and others. Even a good gardener with good seed and soil must know how to water the plant. — “stagnation brings anxiety”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:30 (auto-transcript): “and about others offenses. Stagnation is so long as Baltimore uses this word regularly, stagnation, stagnation, stagnant. Can you imagine you are in a very busy, every crowded place busy and you just stand in one place how do you feel very busy place people are moving from…”

A Bengali Gaudiya Vaishnava dictionary defines aparadha as Radha-sunya, being without Radha. Offences create a situation in which her blessings, mercy and protection are absent.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:54 (auto-transcript): “to water the other plant to grow yes a parada means rada sunya devoid of rada in the godja Vaisnava Tictionary, Bengali version. The theme Apparada is explained or defined as Radha Sunya, devoid of Radha. Simati Radharani is a Ladini Shakti, the internal potency of Krishna.…”

Radharani is Krishna's pleasure potency, the mother of devotion and overseer of the whole realm of bhakti. Without her there is no devotion, without devotion no Krishna, and without Krishna our suffering continues.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:13 (auto-transcript): “No Semati Radharani. Yesterday we already mentioned. Semati Radharani means no Krishna. that's all there's no there's no middle way because devotional means rather than me and what it means so no devotional means no devotional means no Christian no Christian means our…”

We cannot advance without the mercy of Lord Nityananda and Srimati Radharani. Nityananda's mercy comes through service to Vaishnavas and the dust of their feet, as Haridasa Thakura explains in Harinama-cintamani. In Kali-yuga perfection comes by mercy more than by our expertise in sadhana.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:44 (auto-transcript): “The powerful remedy, the doors to the feet of the shadows. We know that we cannot advance without the mercy of Lord Nityananda and the mercy of Shri Mati Radharani. It is through the agencies of these great personalities that we attend Krishna. The mercy of Lord Nityananda…”

Mercy cannot come to an arrogant person. Our minds are so weak that some are offended just by seeing someone; offending any living being is the beginning that leads to offending devotees and Krishna. — “Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:43 (auto-transcript): “So, we need a mercy, and a mercy cannot come from an arrogant person, a music hero said, Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know. It means no pride, no arrogance. That's what it means. Bend down low, and I will teach you what I know.”

Without respect we cannot avoid offences. We call each other Prabhu, 'my master' — how then can I offend or disregard you? Yet we call someone Prabhu and chastise him, which is the opposite. — “It is Prabhu who will chastise us.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:42 (auto-transcript): “We cannot avoid making offences if we don't have respect for others. If it is compositive in our tradition to maintain the culture of respect. That is the reason why we would address somebody, Prabhu, Prabhu, Prabhu. Prabhu. The idea is that you are my master. How can I…”

Maharaj jokes that Brahma was the first hijacker: he stole Krishna's cowherd friends and calves. Once rectified, he prayed to be born as grass in Vraja so the gopis' foot-dust would fall on him — he did not dare ask Krishna directly, so fresh was the offence in his mind.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:38 (auto-transcript): “the life of the brahma everything is very very meaningful and significant the this first person Who started the scene of hijacking? We hear this word, a plane has been hijacked, right? Or someone has been kidnapped. Kignapping or hijacking started from Lord Brahma, not us.…”

Brahma was conscious of his offence and so took a different route to mercy. Knowing what we lack is what lets us pray for strength and mercy. — “We should know where we are weak.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:55 (auto-transcript): “He is conscious of the offenses he committed. He is very, very good. We should be aware of our limitations. We should know where we are weak. That is how we will pray for strength, for mercy. if I know what I lack then it is that I will pray for so the Brahman knows they are…”

To receive mercy we must humble ourselves; without humility there is neither mercy nor freedom from aparadha. — “Without humility, we cannot get mercy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:56 (auto-transcript): “So mercy. To get mercy, we have to humble ourselves. Without humility, we cannot get mercy. And we cannot be free from our parada. So we have a five-minute reflection. Deep, personal questions. One, do I consciously invoke this divine? Mind personalities for their merciful…”

Five minutes of journalling: do I consciously call on these merciful personalities in my daily sadhana? What attitudes or behaviours might be creating a void in my spiritual life?

🎙 Maharaj at 35:16 (auto-transcript): “So we have a five-minute reflection. Deep, personal questions. One, do I consciously invoke this divine? Mind personalities for their merciful presence in my daily sadness. Two, what specific attitudes or behaviors might be creating sunyia, devoid, void in my spiritual life?…”

No one sits carelessly beside a fire. The process of bhakti is like fire, and carelessness brings offences; Krishna consciousness means being conscious of Krishna all the time. — “So carelessness also brings offences, carelessness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:31 (auto-transcript): “So carelessness also brings offences, carelessness. If one is sitting near fire, you cannot be careless. Carelessness is also dangerous. It will bring offences. A process of bhakti like fire. Christianity in 11 countries, like fire. It is a process of bhakti, like fire. So…”

This discussion is for cleansing the heart, not empty talk. Devotional service guarantees growth except where there are offences. That people fall down proves it works: one can only fall from a height.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:34 (auto-transcript): “All right, so we continue with our discussion. This is a discussion designed for cleaning the heart. This is for the heart cleansing, not just empty talks. It's practical activities to do so we can feel our Christian consciousness. So let's continue. devotional service works”

Offences can stall progress for lifetimes and wipe out pious credit; offending a devotee can affect generations of one's family. In the pastime of King Nrga in the Tenth Canto, Krishna warns never to be angry with a brahmana. — “Not only we, generations.”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:16 (auto-transcript): “Offenses stoned our progress, even to the point of stagnating our spiritual groups for lifetimes sometimes offenses can take away lifetimes of pious deposits and credits yeah if we offend a devotee the higher caliber generations of our family members are going to suffer for…”

Like a student who pleases the teacher and moves quickly through the grades, a devotee serving without offences draws the mercy of Radharani and Nityananda, and progress becomes swift, easy and steady.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:49 (auto-transcript): “From another perspective, however, where it is the presence of the mercy of the Larani and Lorde Tenanda, we can accelerate or upgrade our progress by lifts and bounds. Just like a student who places the teacher of Stockton advances rapidly through grades. Similarly, if a…”

Keep a notebook and write daily: what does it feel like when my heart becomes void, and what do I do then? Devotion is not floating; Rupa Gosvami says it gives immediate relief and joy, felt as surely as an injection. An advancing devotee is alarmed, searches for whom he has offended and corrects it at once.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:43 (auto-transcript): “realization through contemplation keep a small notebook for this daily practice throughout our chaotic journey very very very important if we really want to maximize the benefit of what we're doing this particular topic rather soon it is compulsory for us to have a notepad”

children.topic: The astrologer and the magic wand
children.note:
For business or health problems we go and find solutions, even to the astrologer. For spiritual problems we sit and wait for an angel. A friend's guru told him he had no magic wand: do something practical — if you are hungry, look for food. — “do something practically that's idea do something if you're hungry”

🎙 Maharaj at 54:35 (auto-transcript): “So what do you do? You notice that your body is not Okay, what do you do? You'll sit down there. Do nothing. So, we find a solution to it. We'll have difficulty in our office, in our business. We'll find a solution. But when we have difficulty in our business, you'll sit down…”

Before sleeping, list the acharyas of the disciplic succession; before sadhana, invoke them, offering obeisances to each, starting with your spiritual master — remembering them in gratitude and calling them in helplessness. To get Nityananda's and Radharani's mercy, avoid offences by respecting and appreciating everyone. — “you will get all their qualities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:13 (auto-transcript): “Before going to bed, enlist the names of our glorious Guru Parampala and various other Acharya you can recall. It's clear? We have mentioned many times. If you remember our acharyas, if you remember them, if you think of them, if you pray to them, you will get all their…”

Questions and realizations from devotees on Zoom and YouTube.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:00 (auto-transcript): “and we would like to open the floor now for the question, answers or any comments or if somebody had some good introspection between the session and would like to share those. So we are specifically taking the questions from today's session first and then if we have time,…”

children.topic: Q1 · Doesn't surrender mean not acting?
children.note:
If we seek solutions ourselves, does that show a lack of faith that Krishna will help?

🎙 Maharaj at 60:27 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Maharaj please accept my most humble and respectful obeisances unto you Thank you very much Maharaj I have a small question as you mentioned whenever we face any problems we should always try to find solutions for that but we do also say that in Bhakti we try to…”

Faith does not mean inactivity. Waiting at home for the guru to come and take you to hospital, or to bring food because he is omniscient, is foolishness. We make the effort; the result depends on guru and Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:19 (auto-transcript): “and being a dependent person does not mean foolishness it doesn't mean I should be inactive I am sick Krishna you are very merciful gurus are so kind you should know where you are that I'm seeking my she better come here and take me to hospital it's not not a dependence it…”

children.topic: Q2 · Offences we don't know about?
children.note:
What if we offend someone unknowingly and do not even know whom?

🎙 Maharaj at 63:15 (auto-transcript): “Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble obeisances. Maharaj, my question was on offences. If we do any offence unknowingly or by mistake, if we are not aware of it, then what to do at that time? Like our bhakti will go down if we have offended a devotee. And if we don't know…”

As you know when you are sick, you can know: japa has no taste, no enthusiasm for programmes, seeing no pure devotee anywhere — something is wrong. Not noticing means we are not serious.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:44 (auto-transcript): “If we are sick, we should know. If you are sick, you should know I'm sick. my body is not functioning properly we should know the same way if we make offences we have got this cause if we make offences there will be stagnation that means offences are going on now so we should…”

When Rupa Gosvami's meditation broke, he did not say he had seen no one; he concluded he had offended someone, searched, and Krishna showed him the person. Thinking 'if someone is angry it is their problem' is a serious problem.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:46 (auto-transcript): “break the deities you go and break the deities that is one way second way Rupa Goswami when Rupa Goswami noticed that his meditation broke just see he was completely in deep meditation Rupa Goswami was in deep meditation he didn't see at all that somebody came to visit him…”

Avoiding offences with distant devotees is easy; how to tolerate those we live with every day?

🎙 Maharaj at 68:30 (auto-transcript): “and ask a question? Hare Krishna, Srila Gurudev. Thank you so much for the enlightening class. Srila Gurudev, you told us that we should avoid offenses. So when we talk about the devotees who are far from us, to whom we don't meet every day, so it's easy, a bit easy to avoid…”

The issue is the quality of our sadhana and consciousness. A developed devotee who appreciates and respects others handles every situation, near or far. — “It's not about distance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:09 (auto-transcript): “the issue is not the distance the distance we have with the person the issue is our inner development if we develop we are doing our service very nicely they will have the strength to overcome. We have already mentioned many times in this particular discussion how we should…”

We bring friends and relatives to the temple and feel sad when they show no realization.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:43 (auto-transcript): “Hey, Krishna Shlai Gohizeh, please accept my most humble responsibility. Gohizeh, I just wanted to ask one question that sometimes we have to invite our friends and our relatives to this Kaur temple where we make them seek in lectures, aarti and attain all the rituals and at…”

children.topic: Do your duty, leave the result
children.note:
As Krishna told Arjuna, the result is his. They saw the deity and devotees and heard the name; expecting a hundred new devotees will only discourage you.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:21 (auto-transcript): “In Babadigata, Krishna told Ajoun do your duty. Don't expect the result. The result is for me, not for you. So we have to do our duty. The result, forget about the result. Whatever comes, that is not for your duty. Your duty is encourage people in Christian consciousness. So…”

A devotee took his reluctant father, a wood seller, on pilgrimage. At Varanasi the father wept before huge piles of firewood; the son thought his heart had melted, but he was lamenting that he had missed such a lucrative wood business.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:31 (auto-transcript): “when we were talking I was remembering one when one devotee he tried his best to to encourage his father to be a devotee actually there are two two it just came to my mind he's trying his best to encourage his father to be the father is a he's a businessman he sells wood and…”

A devotee cannot feel helpless when praying to the acharyas; it feels mechanical and unhelpful.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:31 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna my dear Shri LaGurudev please accept my humble obeisances onto your lotus feet Guru Dev you mentioned in the class that before starting our sadhana we should always pray to our acharyas in a mood of helplessness but gurudev i am not able to feel helpless while…”

A devotee told Prabhupada he was not humble, so could not offer 'humble obeisances'; Prabhupada asked how else he would become humble. Another said he could not cry for Krishna; Prabhupada said to cry because he could not. Mechanical prayer accumulates into feeling.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:11 (auto-transcript): “One day, one devotee told Prabhupada, I'm not humble. So I'm not open of businesses. I'm not humble. Our tradition is what? Please accept my humble obeisances. I said, Prabhupada, I'm not humble so I can not open of businesses. Prabhupada said, yeah, that's very good. How are…”

Kunti Devi shows that material desire stops heartfelt prayer, so pray for it to leave and take sadhana seriously. — “Strong sadhana brings empowerment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:08 (auto-transcript): “why we don't pray feelingly because of material desires in it Kunti Devi said therefore we should be praying also for material desire to leave us and being engaging seriously in sadhana. children.topic: Q6 · Harsh words to noisy children
children.note:
During a Bhakti-vriksha class a devotee spoke harshly to parents whose children were noisy. Was it an offence?

🎙 Maharaj at 85:41 (auto-transcript): “Shri LaGurude Manisha Mataji You may please Hare Krishna Shri LaGurude Please accept my humble obeisances and your lotus feet Hare Krishna Thank you for the class Gurude Actually I was having a question that this Sunday we were having our Bhakti Vriksha class in the temple…”

Yes: Maharaj recalls his guru comparing harsh words to stoning someone. A teacher may check students; otherwise speak once, and if they don't listen, move the class or use earplugs rather than join their energy.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:40 (auto-transcript): “Aparath like that? Yes, to speak harsh words, to speak harsh words, yes. And Gurudev said it's like stoning a person. Harsh words are stoning a person. So if you are the teacher, yes, the password is good to check the student if someone else is doing the person is careless…”

children.topic: Q7 · Offending someone you can't find
children.note:
At a 24-hour kirtan a devotee played large kartals beside a mataji and only later realised the noise had disturbed her; he would not recognise her now.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:47 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is, I have some realization about what you are saying about offenses. Something happened very in the summertime when we were doing, I think, 24 hours Ketan in Norendravan. I was praying the characters, the big one. And when I was praying, there was this…”

When you cannot find the person, pray to the deities to forgive; Krishna will rectify it.

🎙 Maharaj at 90:30 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, you can pray to the deities to forgive. Pray to the deities. Okay. Yeah, that is the solution. You don't know the person, and you cannot go and touch certain circumstances. You don't know the person. You pray, Krishna will rectify it for you. Thank you. Thank…”

How to protect ourselves from unwanted influence without being offensive?

🎙 Maharaj at 91:06 (auto-transcript): “she is asking harry krishna maharaj please accept my humble obeisances maharaj how to protect ourselves from unwanted unwanted influence without being offensive protect ourselves from unwanted influence without being offensive But if somebody is offering something which you…”

Decline politely what you don't want. If talk turns to nonsense, change the topic, which helps them too; if they are stronger, excuse yourself — 'I have service to do', 'this is too high for me' — and go. Even if they call you proud, just go. — “Excuse yourself and leave.”

🎙 Maharaj at 91:38 (auto-transcript): “But if somebody is offering something which you don't know, which you don't like, somebody is offering something, you can apologize, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm full, I'm sorry, I cannot take it. We should be able to distinguish what is garbage, so we don't respond, we don't…”

nodeData.topic: Session 03 · Offences Against the Holy Name
nodeData.note: SB 5.12.12 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Narottama dasa Thakura's disappearance day Maharaj recalls that the Absolute Truth is revealed only by a great devotee's mercy, then begins the ten offences against the holy name: blaspheming devotees, separating the name from the Lord, disobeying or minimising the guru, and offences to scripture and the name's glories. He urges treating everyone nicely when we cannot tell who is who, looking at our own faults instead of others', and begging humbly for mercy. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Krishna consciousness is the soul's natural, sweet activity, so devotees should have smiling faces. Recalling Bhakti Tirtha Swami's emphasis, Maharaj says we are maintained and nourished by the mercy of Krishna and the devotees — we are kripa-siddhas, perfected by mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:16 (auto-transcript): “we begin our day Radha Sunya just to recap from the previous discussion it's already Bhattisar Mahara was emphasizing that our primarily Krishna consciousness stem from the mercy of Krishna the mercy of devotees the mercy we are nourished we are maintained, we are fed and…”
Jada Bharata tells King Rahugana that the Absolute Truth is not realised by celibacy, household rules, renunciation or severe austerities, but only by the mercy of great devotees.

Many Vaishnavas recite the ten offences daily; we should also develop strategies to avoid them.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:51 (auto-transcript): “Radha Sunia, Missing Mercy, Understanding and Overcoming Apparat of One, Offenses Against the Chanting of the Only Needs, Introduction, The Daily Reminder We Need, Daily Reminder We Need is what? So many Vaisalas have a daily habit of reciting the Das Nam Apparatus, the Ten…”

Reciting the offences takes three minutes in the morning, and Maharaj admits he does not remember them all day. Even during the recitation some devotees jump in and disturb others. One strategy: never speak badly of anyone, especially devotees. — “it's only 3 minutes in the morning”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:56 (auto-transcript): “This is what we do. we recite the 10 offenses how many minutes it takes? 3 minutes and the whole day we remember them I don't know but for me I don't remember them it's only 3 minutes in the morning not to criticize black women who have dedicated his or her life to the…”

Blaspheming devotees who spread the holy name is the worst offence; the name, identical with Krishna, will not tolerate it even from one who passes as great. The text even names Lord Shiva to show how serious it is — though as the greatest Vaishnava he would never do it.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:51 (auto-transcript): “Offenses 1 and 2. Blasphemy of the devotees of the Lord who are engaged in the propagation of the Hare Krishna is the worst offense at the Lord's feet or the Holy Name. The Nam Prabhu who is identical with Krishna will never tolerate such blasphemous activities even from one…”

children.topic: Offence 2: the name is the Lord
children.note:
Vishnu's name, form, qualities and pastimes are all transcendental. Separating the Lord from his name, form and qualities, thinking them material, or equating the names of demigods like Shiva with Vishnu's, is offensive.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:07 (auto-transcript): “In this material world, the holy name of Vishnu is all auspicious. Vishnu's name, Vishnu's form, Vishnu's qualities, and Vishnu's past things are all transcendental, absolute knowledge. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was so angry. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, what day he was shouting?…”

Caitanya Mahaprabhu, who never spoke such words, shouted that he would destroy one who said the Lord has no form, name or qualities — such a person was cutting his body to pieces. His name, form, qualities, pastimes and abode are eternal.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:23 (auto-transcript): “Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was so angry. Sri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, what day he was shouting? I will destroy him. I will kill him. What he never had, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, was used this kind of word before. What? When are you going to destroy, my Lord? See, that man was cutting…”

children.topic: A secretary in the director's chair
children.note:
A secretary who sits in the director's chair is fired at once; one who declares himself prime minister is arrested before he finishes. Yet people declare themselves God for years and nothing seems to happen. — “A secretary cannot be a director,”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:12 (auto-transcript): “A secretary cannot be a director, except if he gets promotion to become a director. Only then he can be a director. But as far as he is a secretary, he is not a director. There's a difference. So if one plays a secretary on the restaurant's chair, it's an offense. Even if the…”

Krishna is taking serious action imperceptibly. After death, religious cheaters who declared themselves God are crushed for ages in Kumbhipaka, like sugarcane in a press, in the subtle body. Maya's trick is to make them think they are free and worshipped. — “The Lord is not keeping quiet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:50 (auto-transcript): “So what about spiritual life? A person can go on and on and on and on and declare himself as God. And it seems nothing is happening to the person. But the moment you come out and declare, I am the prime minister of this country, the next moment you're arrested. The next…”

To disobey the spiritual master, consider him material and envy his position. Krishna consciousness is reality — something felt, experienced and relished — not fiction.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:12 (auto-transcript): “Next. Offenses 3 to 6. To disobey the order of the spiritual master or to consider the spiritual master to be material and therefore to envy his exalted position. Very nice experience in the fourth tantosimed babotani. Indra was thinking his spiritual master, at this point…”

In the Bhagavatam, Indra, surrounded by worshipping demigods, felt no need to rise for his guru Brihaspati — he had already offered respects that morning. Maharaj asks: if your guru knows nothing, how intelligent are you to accept a fool as guru? — “What an intelligent person are you?”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:34 (auto-transcript): “Very nice experience in the fourth tantosimed babotani. Indra was thinking his spiritual master, at this point I'll offer business to you. it's okay now if I don't offer now it's okay after all now I have also I have done my part by offering a business to you as a disciple…”

If you abandon the medicine the doctor prescribed, the doctor does not suffer; you do. The guru's order comes from the Supersoul; follow it and you succeed. — “it is you who are going to suffer”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:39 (auto-transcript): “special massage and then disobeying the other i've given this example many times especially massage is like a doctor the doctor if one has gone to see a doctor and get a prescription from the doctor what to do for the sickness it is our duty to take the medicine as the doctor…”

Without a pure devotee's mercy everything stays difficult. Serving him, following his instructions, and taking the dust of his feet, his remnants and the water that washed his feet are potent ingredients that guarantee purity.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:49 (auto-transcript): “Because we need the mercy to grow. Without the mercy we can never understand anything. Everything will make difficult and unsuccessful Until we have the mercy of the pure devotee. There, it is a trunk, an express role for success. Express way for liberation is service of pure…”

Minimising a pure devotee as an ordinary person usually comes from envy. Pure devotees are the easiest to criticise because their activities are beyond a neophyte's understanding.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:48 (auto-transcript): “So one should be very careful to avoid minimizing the spiritualness, thinking of him as an ordinary person. And then naturally one will become envious. To think of him as an ordinary person due to envy. Envy. Are you pure? Are you better than me? Are you pure? What's the…”

In Pune a devotee told Maharaj he saw no pure devotee in the room — yet he had taken initiation. Maharaj laughed: then he took the guru as a fashion, which the scripture condemns.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:22 (auto-transcript): “This time I was in Pune. I said, Mahara, where is the pure devotee in this room? I have not seen anyone. I was laughing. I was laughing at him. I was laughing at him. I said, what is the guru? He mentioned. I said, oh. Okay, so you don't see me. is a purity and he went to…”

Brahmanas were outraged that Narottama dasa Thakura, born outside a brahmana family, initiated brahmanas — yet he is an expansion of Nityananda Prabhu. Maharaj tells how Durga herself told two brahmana boys to take initiation from him. Seeing a pure Vaishnava as ordinary is already living in hell.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:46 (auto-transcript): “was not so popular, Narutam Dasekura. He appeared in the Sudra family. He didn't appear in the Brahmanas family. So the Brahmanas did not consider somebody. They look at him as somebody. It's not another case. Until when Narutam Dasekura initiated Brahmana, then the Brahmana…”

At an international leaders' meeting a senior leader told Maharaj there were no pure devotees, pointing at a respected Vaishnava as a pretender — then stood to offer obeisances to someone he had called a neophyte. Many think worse in their minds.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:11 (auto-transcript): “One day we were sitting in a leader's meeting. All the leaders around the world were sitting in a meeting in a Michael. And one heavyweight JVC man was sitting on our table. And two of us were doing something. And he was sitting. Two of us were there. He never spoke to me…”

If you do not know who is who, do not judge; treat every devotee as well as you can. That is our security against offending a pure devotee. — “If you don't know who is who, please don't discriminate.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:38 (auto-transcript): “we are mentioning these things also be careful you've got to be careful if you don't know who is who do not judge if you don't know who is who do not judge the security for in your fight devotee who does not know who is who, it is to treat all devotees the best you can,…”

children.topic: Offences to scripture and the name
children.note:
Scriptures guide like a mother, so blaspheming them is dangerous. Even scriptures for other levels, such as the Bible, are Krishna's deliberate mercy to elevate people; some devotees came to Krishna through them.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:54 (auto-transcript): “Blathomia of Vedic literature, or literature in portions of the Vedic version. Literatures are considered like a modern. Because the scriptures, they guide us like a modern. The one who guides is a mother. Mother guides. So sometimes you see neophyte people, they will burn…”

Letters are pure; the person arranging them makes words good or bad. Interpretation simply means explaining — mundane interpretation is the problem. Leave the name as it is and chant it: like poison, it acts whether we understand or not.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:29 (auto-transcript): “to eat i will try to be fed i will try to maintain to give some interpretation on the holy name of the lord we usually say mundane interpretation because when you say interpretation see this english everything is very meaningful in the beginning we would have made this…”

The demons of Lanka scorned 'just the name Rama', though it had already carried stones across the ocean, and were destroyed. The name's potency cannot be fully explained; the name is even more merciful than Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:52 (auto-transcript): “the glories of the holy name to be imaginary it might be like, oh this is an exaggeration, it's an imagination, how can the name be like this? No, it's not true. It's an offense. It's an offense. The example we gave last time is Rakshasa, who came from Lanka. They got…”

Have I criticised devotees as neophytes, focusing on their faults rather than their service? Everyone carries two bags: in front our flattering glorification, behind the faults we need to work on. A sincere devotee swaps them.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:51 (auto-transcript): “going internal through reflections yes that is where we are personal introspection five minutes five minutes personal introspection reflect on these questions one regarding devotees eh have i spoken critically about devotees engaging christian consciousness considering them a…”

In a dark room we see nothing; with the light on we see what is out of place. Turn on the light in the room of your consciousness — while we look at others' faults, when do we work on our own?

🎙 Maharaj at 62:28 (auto-transcript): “that we should all of us should put the light the light in the room of our consciousness to put on the light in the room of our consciousness we should put on the light in the room of our consciousness to put it on when the light is off in the room we don't see anything it is…”

Do I see my spiritual master with reverence, or as a mundane person prone to misjudgement, sickness and anger? Do I have 365 reasons for not executing his order?

🎙 Maharaj at 64:19 (auto-transcript): “Two, towards Guru. Do I see my special master with reverence or do I sometimes consider him a mundane person who is prone to misjudgment sickness anger and old age i'll just give an example of really one devotee is oh my guru doesn't know it doesn't do anything i know better…”

A devotee shares that hurtful behaviour makes him critical and dry in chanting. Maharaj: a cat sees what the dog sees and stays peaceful; the dog barks because the same garbage is in it. The temple is a hospital of the sick, each with a different load of karma, so look at yourself.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:41 (auto-transcript): “One time, I think it was in a horseshoe. I think in horseshoe we went at that time. I was sharing with devotees that, you see, a dog and a cat. Yes, Maraj. The dog. And the cat, both of them are animals with four legs. So a cat will see what you are seeing and just close his…”

This process is a hospital; take the medicine carefully and the cure is sure. Rupa Gosvami joins patience with confidence and enthusiasm. — “patience and enthusiasm”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:54 (auto-transcript): “Yeah, that is going on every day. And this process is designed for that to help us make a hospital. So we all come here. The only thing is for us to carefully take our medication. That's the only thing we need to do. If you carefully take our medication, it is sure that we're…”

After devotees share about correcting others and about bad association in Vrindavan, Maharaj notes that the same words can land as a stone or a lotus, and that we see unlimited faults or unlimited good according to our desire. Where devotees discuss Krishna becomes a holy place. — “association is very very powerful it can break us or it can make us”

🎙 Maharaj at 85:18 (auto-transcript): “yeah association is very very powerful it can break us or it can make us depending on the quality of association. As you say, with a pure devotee, you become a pure devotee. If you are sick with non-devotee, you become a non-devotee. If you want to see fault, you will see…”

children.topic: Offence 7: sinning on the name's strength
children.note:
To keep sinning while thinking that chanting will neutralise the reactions is the greatest offence at the feet of the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 87:33 (auto-transcript): “next one. Offense number seven. To think that seeing the Hare Krishna mantra can contract all sinful reactions. One may therefore go on with all his sinful activities and then, as a At the same time, chant Hare Krishna mantra to neutralize them. He is a greatest offense at…”

Ajamila called his son out of fear, without deliberate offence, and was delivered. Thinking 'I'll chant later' is a dangerous mentality.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:07 (auto-transcript): “Jamila, he chanted Hare Krishna, although he was calling his son. But there was no offense. There was no offense in him. It is not a deliberate offense. It's not that he was calling his son to consider that he's going to hell. it's just called out of fear by support so this…”

Planning extra rounds or an eclipse bath at Kurukshetra next month so one can offend now is very dangerous. One who offends Krishna can take shelter of the name, but who saves one who offends the name? A weak devotee's lapses differ from deliberate wrongdoing. — “That is very, very, very dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 88:42 (auto-transcript): “and for one to think that yeah it's 64 rounds on a currency day taking birth in Ganga we see the postcard in the lunar eclipse and also So, give charge there and also, and the Khrushetra and the solar lunar eclipse. And there I can purify myself. So, next month I'm going to…”

List everything your guru or Srila Prabhupada expects of you, then see how far your life aligns. Every teacher and parent hopes the children succeed; we expect much of the guru but forget he expects of us. Repeat it in hard times — a U-turn in devotion. — “So why we don't think that he's expecting something from us?”

🎙 Maharaj at 92:09 (auto-transcript): “better okay i think that should be network so i was saying that generally we expect we have expectation from the Guru, but we don't think that the Guru also have expectation from us. So this is very, very good in introspection. So you can really understand that, yes, the…”

Three questions at the end of the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 95:02 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we are ready. Okay. So anyone who has questions, please raise your hand. Yes, Madhuji. Hare Krishna Shrila Gurudev, Lennar Pranam. Thank you so much Shrila Gurudev for adding in so much nectar to this session. I had a couple of questions, but maybe I'll ask just one of…”

If good sadhana pleases the guru, what more makes one perfected by mercy?

🎙 Maharaj at 95:24 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna Shrila Gurudev, Lennar Pranam. Thank you so much Shrila Gurudev for adding in so much nectar to this session. I had a couple of questions, but maybe I'll ask just one of them. It was also from the last class and what you mentioned today. It is that we will be…”

Even good sadhana needs mercy. Bhaktivinoda Thakura begged for the name and received it. Demanding prema as a right is arrogance; beggars have no choice, as they say in West Africa. Like Brahma after stealing the boys, approach humbly. Prabhupada writes that a pure devotee's mercy makes regulated practice easy. — “We are beggars of mercy.”

🎙 Maharaj at 96:18 (auto-transcript): “to be able to do successful sadhana we need a message that is why Bhaktivinoda Takura is teaching Bhaktivinoda Takura begged for the holy name, and he received it. That's what Mjeev Jaga said. He said, alone, I have no strength to change the holy name of Krishna. I beg you,…”

children.topic: Q2 · No time to pray first
children.note:
A busy devotee rushes into japa without praying, and when he does pray it is mechanical.

🎙 Maharaj at 102:03 (auto-transcript): “yes, there is Anurag Prabhuji Gurudev going to ask I think every day that tomorrow I will before starting my sadhana I will pray but in the heat of the moment I pick up my bead and start Hare Krishna Hare Krishna like that Maharaj I was just thinking just I was contemplating…”

If your girlfriend gave you an appointment you would find time; a feast of your favourite dish too. Start by serving devotees, even mechanically — invite them home, serve them on parikrama; in time it softens the heart. — “It's a question of interest, that's all I think.”

🎙 Maharaj at 103:22 (auto-transcript): “good if your girlfriend give your appointment to come and see her will you have time or not yes man you have to it's not because you don't have time It's a question of interest, that's all I think. Yes, my lad. The only name is not attractive. If it's attractive, we'll have…”

Some senior devotees say Prabhupada said things because he was old or because of where he was born. What is the danger?

🎙 Maharaj at 106:05 (auto-transcript): “So it's from Gauradaya Natha Prabhu, he's writing I heard from some senior devotees speak like this, Shrila Prabhupada said this or that because he was an old person and because he was born in a certain place. So this is why he speaks like that. Can Your Holiness speak about…”

Such statements make Prabhupada a conditioned soul and Krishna an Indian man. A sincere devotee recognises at once that this is a fall in consciousness; realising it only after fifty years is a chronic disease.

🎙 Maharaj at 106:33 (auto-transcript): “We cannot compare how dangerous this is. We cannot compare how dangerous it is. The statement shows that profit is a conditioned soul. That is what the statement shows. so it is dangerous and then just look at how foolish we are when did you get to know the properties from…”

People who know nothing of him see from his picture that he is no ordinary person. No one unempowered could spread Krishna consciousness around the world alone. Maharaj says nobody else could have melted his hard heart; as a seeker he would clear all books from his table except the Gita.

🎙 Maharaj at 109:32 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada is a pure devotee. And it's not just a fanatical statement. I have met so many people who never know anything about the Prabhupada, who doesn't understand the question. By looking at the Prabhupada picture of the books, This man is not an ordinary person. Karameh,…”
