maps.title: Radha Sunya · Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities

nodeData.topic: Session 26 · Bhrigu Muni Tests the Deities
nodeData.note: SB 10.89 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells how Bhrigu Muni tested Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu with a mental, a verbal and finally a physical offence, and how only Lord Vishnu answered with humility. The power of humility is accepting responsibility; like turning on a light that makes a thief run, increasing devotion dissolves conflict instead of fighting it. In the questions he speaks on tension with one's guru, offending people who later become devotees, and how hearing turns the goal of life into reality. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Day 26 looks at Bhrigu Muni's search for the Supreme. Sages gathered for a sacrifice could not agree whether Brahma, Shiva or Vishnu should be worshipped as supreme.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:19 (auto-transcript): “Brighamuni was deported by an assembly of sages. to make an appreciation of the three predominating deities in the universe Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu to discover which of them is supreme it is said that the great sages Narada Muni saw these great sages assembled together for a…”

A heated scriptural argument broke out, and since everyone quoted scripture no one could settle it. Narada Muni, always eager to help, proposed Bhrigu, whom he felt had some pride.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:28 (auto-transcript): “And there were a heated scriptural argument. Heated scriptural argument among the sages. And there were no conclusions because they were all quoting from Sarsus. Therefore, Narimuni, who is always interested in helping living entities. He wanted to help his brother, whom he…”

The sages declared full confidence in Bhrigu: whomever he found to be supreme, they would accept without doubt and follow exactly.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:25 (auto-transcript): “According to Chetan Bhagwat, all the sages said, we have confidence we faith in you that whomever you will come to declare as supreme we will never have any doubt about that we will follow you exactly please go we are waiting for you so now Brighamuni sorry yeah Brighamuni…”

Bhrigu first approached his own father, Brahma, without any mood of respect, and Brahma was disturbed and angered.

nodeData.topic: Session 27 · Mother Sachi's Offence
nodeData.note: Caitanya Bhagavata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. During the Mahaprakasa pastime Caitanya Mahaprabhu gave prema to everyone but refused his own mother, Sachi, because in her mind she had called Advaita Acharya 'Dvaita' for drawing her sons away. Maharaj stresses that unspoken thoughts are recorded by the Supersoul and in time become words and actions, and shows how Sachi was rectified by taking the dust of Advaita's feet. In the questions he explains why we suffer, how to help a wayward mother, and how to stop offensive thoughts at the level of the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:22 (auto-transcript): “Mother Satya's rectification. Mother Satya saw this unconscious state of Adota Acharya as an opportunity to take the dust from his feet. She submitted herself in the mood of his servant and begged forgiveness in this way. As she was touching Advaita Acharya's lotus feet, she…”

This happened in the Lord's aisvarya mood, outside the usual etiquette of mother and son. Through it he shows the world to be careful in association and avoid offences; we must let scripture guide us so that all we do accelerates bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 81:50 (auto-transcript): “The universal teaching. First, we should understand that Lord Chaitanya was in the Aishwarya Bar, in the Mahaprakash. Otherwise, this incident was outside the boundaries of etiquette involved in their usual relationship. Sachin is his mother, and not an ordinary mother. The…”

Write about a time attachment to family clashed with spiritual principles, plan rectification for any criticism of authorities, and name one concrete way to honour someone you have criticised.

🎙 Maharaj at 83:33 (auto-transcript): “Realization through Contemplation. Continue your 30-day notebook where today's focus on intimate relationships and spiritual principles. Family vs. Spiritual Authority Assessment 4 minutes Write about a time when family attachment conflicted with spiritual principles. How…”

Questions from devotees on Zoom.

🎙 Maharaj at 86:03 (auto-transcript): “Now we would like to take question answers. devotees may raise their hand we have Shweta Mataji Mataji can you unmute yourself Hare Krishna Guru Maharaj Tenvat Pranam my humble and respectful obeisance is on to you Guru Maharaj I wanted to ask that like in the world there is…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why is the world suffering?
children.note:
Is the suffering in the world due to impious acts of past lives or to Vaishnava-aparadha?

🎙 Maharaj at 86:28 (auto-transcript): “to ask that like in the world there is suffering this world is full of sufferings are these sufferings due to impious activities done by us in the previous lives or to the Vaishnava Aparads, how can we understand the sufferings which people are in journal there are many kinds…”
All suffering comes from sinful activities — violating the recommendations of scripture or offending Vaishnavas. Maharaj has Bhagavad-gita 6.40 read.

children.topic: No one suffers for doing good
children.note:
No one suffers because he chants Hare Krishna or is absorbed in Krishna; the verse glorifies devotional service. — “One who does good cannot suffer.”

🎙 Maharaj at 88:47 (auto-transcript): “One who does good cannot suffer. Only sinful activities make us to suffer. Either we have offended Vaishnavais, we have violated the regulated principles in the scripture. Sinful activities bring suffering. Yes, that's all. No one can do good. Now he called one who does good…”

People complain they help others and get no gratitude. But what we receive now is the result of the past; the good we do now will bear fruit later.

🎙 Maharaj at 90:50 (auto-transcript): “So we cannot suffer because of doing good. I have told many devotions. don't lament for doing something good don't do that yes i'm helping people i'm doing this i'm doing that but people are ungrateful they're not they're not reciprocations i say why are you lamenting for…”

A devotee's injured, ageing mother has spent her life moving from one relationship to another. How can she help her?

🎙 Maharaj at 92:50 (auto-transcript): “with our dealings with family but I was thinking yesterday day something happened like my mother she lives close to me like 40 minutes by car and she's living in a farm and there is my younger brother living there she she hurt her arm but I knew that every everybody was…”

children.topic: Go and serve her in person
children.note:
Visit physically, spend an hour or two, massage her and give her prasada, and then gently suggest she now think of God. On the phone she would only resent being taught by her daughter; service will penetrate her heart. — “I'm sure it will be different.”

🎙 Maharaj at 95:14 (auto-transcript): “you should go there you should visit her physically because she hurts herself you should go there physically at least spend one or two hours with her then you can gently tell her mommy for a long time for her whole life after men, men, men, men now you're getting old Can't…”

children.topic: Q3 · Stopping thoughts in the mind
children.note:
If thoughts become words and then actions, how do we reject them at the level of the mind?

🎙 Maharaj at 97:10 (auto-transcript): “So, in the lecture you have mentioned that from the mind, it comes to the words and one day it will come to the action. So, how to reject that thoughts, Maharaj, from the mind level itself? A devotee will practice rejecting all the offerings of the mind by engaging the mind…”

We may not have the power simply to stop thinking, but we can engage the mind in hearing and talking about Krishna and planning devotional service. Keep repeating a negative thought about someone and one day you will say it to them. — “That's how we'll change it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 97:27 (auto-transcript): “A devotee will practice rejecting all the offerings of the mind by engaging the mind in planning about Krishna conscious activities. We don't have the power to today, no more. We cannot do like that. But we can engage the mind in spiritual activities by not keeping thinking…”

Thinking the other person cannot hear our thoughts is a mistake; the Supersoul hears and arranges for them to come out. What we constantly meditate on becomes our future — this society exists to transform the mind into Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 99:08 (auto-transcript): “so you're not going to respond. In Krishna, since the super soul is hearing, it is the super soul who arrange it and one day it will come out so we should not keep those things in the mind and we have discussed many times if we keep them in the mind we are culturing nations…”

Tomorrow ends Bhishma Pancaka and Kartik, with the rasa-lila festival. Maharaj asks everyone to cook sweet rice and leave it under the moon overnight.

🎙 Maharaj at 101:30 (auto-transcript): “Tomorrow is the last day of Bishma Panchakar, the end of Karatek. A wonderful, a wonderful celebration, like Tulsi, Viva Ha, Salagam Sila, Bishma Day of Living, the material was for spiritual world, Numbaraka Acharya, and Rasa Lila. rasalila rasalila goes with sweet rice so i…”

Tired after the rasa dance, Krishna and the gopis will enjoy it; Maharaj wants to see their finger marks in the remnants. He playfully warns that forgetting will earn a punishment, and recalls Mother Yasoda's loving cooking for her son. — “i want all of you to make sweet rice for krishna”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:04 (auto-transcript): “rasalila rasalila goes with sweet rice so i want all of you to make sweet rice for krishna and i want to see after tomorrow morning krishna's lotus fingers inside the sweet rice because that is the way we offer we'll offer you from the mind Oh, cookie, put it under the moon.…”

nodeData.topic: Session 28 · Perfecting the Yajna
nodeData.note: Mahabharata · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On the last day of the series Maharaj tells how the bell at Yudhisthira's great sacrifice would not ring because Draupadi had mentally criticised a simple Vaishnava brahmana's way of eating. However perfect our arrangements, success depends on pleasing Krishna and on the quality of our relationships; offences withdraw from our spiritual bank account faster than we deposit. In a long question session he explains why mental offences still count, how faith grows, and what a real service attitude is — love, not salary. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
As Maharaj relates from the Mahabharata, at the close of Yudhisthira's great Rajasuya sacrifice a bell in the arena was to ring by itself to show that everything was perfect. The ceremony ended, but the bell stayed silent.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:22 (auto-transcript): “The bell did not ring. The Mahabharata described how Yudhisthira Maharaj was once performing a very elaborate Sahaja Shuiar sacrifice. At the close of the Yagya, something very special was expected to happen. A bell situated in the center of the arena was supposed to ring of…”

Pale with anxiety — an imperfect sacrifice can bring inauspiciousness — Yudhisthira turned to Krishna. Krishna said one party had not been honoured: a humble, pure, simple, austere Vaishnava brahmana.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:45 (auto-transcript): “Krishna's Diagnosis Yerusha was shocked and pale. And turning to Krishna, he called out, Hey Govinda, what happened? Krishna looked at him in a very grave way and said that all the parties meant to be honoured and served, and the sacrifice had not been honoured and served.”

Arjuna found such a brahmana in a hut in a nearby village. He declined to come to so much pomp, until he heard that Krishna would be there and saw a chance for darshan.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:52 (auto-transcript): “Arjuna, upon hearing this, immediately tried to find such a Brahmana Vaisnava. He ran to a nearby village and in a little hut found a very pure Brahmana, who he then invited to the Grand Raja Surya ceremony. The Vaislama Brahmana was not interested in being around so much…”

Draupadi cooked a wonderful feast for the brahmana, yet after he ate the bell still did not ring. Krishna explained that someone in the family had offended him.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:06 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadhi's mental offense. At the Jagya, they worshipped the Brahmana. Dhopadhi made a wonderful feast. And after the Brahmana had eaten, they bailed stilt in notary. Now Yudhisthva was really in anxiety. Hey, Govinda, what shall I do? What happened? Krishna explained that.”

As part of his austerity the brahmana always mixed all his food together, and he did the same with Draupadi's gorgeous, carefully arranged plate.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:05 (auto-transcript): “The Brahmana had an unusual habit that went hand in hand with his austerities. Whatever he ate, he made all the preparations together. Even though Draupadi had prepared a gorgeous plate of food, he still followed his usual practice. Although he made an opulent and aromatic…”

After so much effort Draupadi thought: this uncultured village man is mixing everything up. That mental offence blocked the perfection of the sacrifice.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:14 (auto-transcript): “Doppadi, after so much elaborate preparation and effort, became angry when he saw his habits, thinking, this uncut village boy is merging everything together, running the mill, running the mill. What a fool, uncultured person.”

children.topic: Everything in place but one heart
children.note:
Maharaj describes how Draupadi, expert in deity worship, arranged each preparation in order, and how the brahmana mixed khichri, sweet rice, halava, sabji and puris together. The place, the ingredients and the mantras were perfect — only one person had been offended, and that was enough.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:38 (auto-transcript): “Dhopadi cooked so nice preparations and arranged them systematically. He arranged them nicely, systematically, in all different places, as you can see in the picture. He was nicely assembled, perfect, in order, because he knows how to worship deity, so he followed the deity…”

Have I judged a devotee's eating, dress or manners as uncultured? What thoughts arise, and how can I turn critical thoughts into appreciative ones? Why was Draupadi's unspoken criticism powerful enough to stop the sacrifice?

🎙 Maharaj at 24:36 (auto-transcript): “Personal Reflection Have I ever judged a devotee's eating habits, devotee's dress, or mannerisms as of cultures? What thoughts arise when I see these devotees who don't exist? How can I transform critical thought into appreciative wants?”

Arjuna begged the brahmana to return. Draupadi served an even grander feast; he mixed everything again — and when he finished, the bells rang and the devotees were in ecstasy.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:02 (auto-transcript): “thing The perfect second attempt Arjuna went back to the Brahmana and begged please He must come again. This time, Draupadi made an even more fantastic feast and placed it before the Brahmana. When he sat down, he once again mixed everything together and against fire.”

We may have so many things in place, but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:20 (auto-transcript): “The purpose is rather easy to understand. We may have so many things in place but we must always be careful about the quality of our relationships. In Kali Yuga we are not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter”

In Kali-yuga, Maharaj's text says, Krishna is lenient with offensive thoughts — otherwise we would all be finished — and gives credit for healthy thoughts even when we cannot complete the service.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “not held responsible for offensive thoughts. Otherwise, we will all be finished. As a matter of fact, it is quite the opposite. In Kaluga, if we think healthy thoughts, Krishna will give us credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is…”

Small thinking and acting bring small results. When Krishna is pleased, miracles can and must happen beyond our intellectual or financial resources. — “Think big, not small.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:15 (auto-transcript): “credit even if we cannot finish service. That is true. Think big, not small. This is another reason why we must be careful not to think small. If we think and act small, then there will be small results. We should try to realize that when Krishna is pleased, miracles can…”

Results that match our resources are simply good management. When results go far beyond our effort, Krishna's sakti is active; when Krishna and guru are not pleased, great effort brings diminishing returns.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:13 (auto-transcript): “resources, we can call this good management, but it's not necessarily spiritual. When there's a high level of spirituality, things happen even beyond our normal capacity and resources. It means that Krishna is coming through and the Krishna Shakti is present and active. We…”

Taking darshan, offering water to tulasi, chanting our rounds — through devotion we keep depositing credits in a spiritual bank account.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:46 (auto-transcript): “Taking inventory. We are engaging in devotion and constantly depositing and receiving credits. We take darshan, take terranalit, water to sea, and churn our arms. We should not think fructively about these activities. But by this process, we are actually building up our…”

When we commit offences against others we withdraw faster than we deposit; whatever strength we had whittles away and we become different persons, drying up where once we had taste.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:17 (auto-transcript): “As we are committing upon others, even though we are depositing, we are also withdrawing even more quickly. We started to withdraw more than we deposited. And after a while, even though we may have had the world's strength and opulence, It all whittles away and we become…”

At a low ebb, immediately investigate whether offences are making us lose focus and appreciation for what our acharyas have given.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:11 (auto-transcript): “It is so important to revisit and investigate our practice when we find ourselves at a low ebb. In our devotional service, we should immediately start taking an inventory to see if our paradigms are causing us to lose focus and appreciation for what our good and greater…”

List recent mental criticisms and turn them into appreciation; weigh deposits against withdrawals; ask what may stop the bell of success in a current project, and which relationship needs healing.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:50 (auto-transcript): “Continue your 30-day notebook with today's focus on perfecting our spiritual tagger Mental Offense Inventory 4 minutes Write about recent times you mentally criticize other devotees' habits or mannerisms Hydropody Identify thoughts how uncultured or how inappropriate commit…”

Questions from devotees on the last day of the series.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

A devotee asks Maharaj to clarify whether offences made only in the mind count in Kali-yuga.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “is a I'm going to do this question she's asking, because some days ago, your holiness mentioned that a devotee was saying that in this Kali Yuga, if we commit some offense in the mind, but we don't act improperly, this is not going to count so much as used to be in other…”

Maharaj has already answered: Sachi said nothing aloud, only in her mind, yet the Lord declared she would not get prema until she begged Advaita's forgiveness. She is an eternal associate who came to teach us; she cannot really offend.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:32 (auto-transcript): “I did, I did already. We interrupted the past time of Sachimata. Anyone remember, we mentioned Sachimata. She didn't say anything outside to Adwita Chari. in her mind. Who says he's a dueter? For me, he's dueter Maya. He's not a dueter. He's duplicitous. That was in the mind.…”

Yudhisthira lost everything at dice to teach us not to gamble; Sita stepped out of Lakshmana's circle and suffered in Lanka to show what disobeying an instruction brings. And Krishna stayed with Yudhisthira in his palace, not with the austere yogis in the forest. — “For us, this is a teaching.”

🎙 Maharaj at 67:31 (auto-transcript): “For Advaita, Acharya, Sachi Mata, Chita Mahaprabhu, and all is associated, this is their pastime. For us, this is a teaching. Do you understand? For us, it is teaching. For them, it is a pastime. It is not a teaching. Because a teacher must know what is teaching. If you don't…”

A devotee asks, in Hindi, how to get rid of bad thoughts that come and go.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:06 (auto-transcript): “she's asking that mentally we have these thoughts sometimes they are good sometimes they are bad but the bad thoughts how can we get rid of them mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure…”

Only a pure devotee is free of them; they are old impressions cultivated since time immemorial. When one comes, ask Krishna's forgiveness, don't meditate on it, let it go, and keep practising until the karmic account is empty. — “until you become a pure devotee”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:17 (auto-transcript): “mentally if mentally you get rid of them by practice only a pure devotee will be free from this thing until you become a pure devotee they will come sometimes and go now what we should do is not to keep such that thumb when they come we should say ah a demon Christian please…”

A devotee confesses that her faith in Krishna consciousness, and even in Maharaj, is not yet strong, though she is trying.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:31 (auto-transcript): “Shiloh Gurudev she's saying that she is constantly also thinking about everything you say like in one of the classes you said that our problem is that we are not Krishna consciousness and her faith is not strong yet she's also confessing that in you also her faith is still…”

Faith grows as we practise in good association. A neophyte's faith is like a candle a hand can put out; continued step by step it becomes immovable like a mountain, as the pure devotee's. — “That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice.”

🎙 Maharaj at 76:01 (auto-transcript): “The faith continues to grow as we continue to practice. That's how the faith comes, as we continue to practice. We don't have faith for anything in this ministry. We don't have faith for anything. But when we continue to practice in good association with pure devotees, then…”

A devotee asks what a service attitude is and how to increase it. Service is what connects us to Krishna and the spiritual master — indeed it is the glue in every relationship.

🎙 Maharaj at 77:29 (auto-transcript): “please accept my humble obeisances thank you um so what does it mean by uh sincerity of purpose is it like service attitude in whatever we do maharaj and like we're knowing why we are doing what we are doing and how we are doing is it uh the same thing uh or i mean basically…”

Both lust and love seek satisfaction; the difference is for whom. A worker who serves only for salary leaves when it stops — that is lust. A disciple who serves the spiritual master without expectation, just to please him, has love. — “for love i'm doing it for you not for me”

🎙 Maharaj at 79:15 (auto-transcript): “who is explaining the difference between the lost and love so proper give example lost and lost all of them contains the same thing all again have the same thing sanctification but lost sanctification love sanctification so what's the difference the difference is that for…”

When Mahaprabhu came to Ramakeli, the ruler heard of a crying Bengali sannyasi. A servant belittled him, but the ruler said: millions follow this man without salary — only God can do that, so let no one disturb him.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:49 (auto-transcript): “sanctification for me lost love so when a lot of time harper visited ram kelly and a push and sha now a push in the shower he got the news that one sanyasi from Bengali is here. He's always crying. Maybe he has no food to eat. He's always crying. Hunger cannot allow him to be…”

Maharaj recalls nine devotees sent to open a temple in Ibadan, Nigeria. He was the pujari; returning from sankirtan he had to pick flowers, and a godbrother always excused himself — 'that is your service.' The joy at an opportunity to serve shows a good servant.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:35 (auto-transcript): “I remember I was telling some devotees some of our sweet good memories in our bhakti days sweet good memories in our bhakti days in the good day of sent us to one city here in Nigeria. We were nine devotees. We were sent to a place called Ibadan. So we went to start the…”

Krishna told Narada only the dust of a devotee's feet would cure his headache. Others refused for fear of hell, but the gopis at once offered theirs; Narada fell silent in contemplation of what pure love is.

🎙 Maharaj at 88:12 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna was very happy that he started teaching many devotees about their life. One day, Krishna told, I'm bleeding, my head is going to split any moment from now. Why? Terrible headache. My headache is going to split now. Krishna is telling to Narada Muni. Narada Muni,…”

children.topic: Without service a devotee is dead
children.note:
In the Damodara-lila the boiling milk, seeing it had no service, wanted to die. Love is action: 'can I do it tomorrow?' is lip service, and for those who don't know service, it feels like punishment. Jatayu fought Ravana knowing he would lose, and left his body in glorious service.

🎙 Maharaj at 91:34 (auto-transcript): “We're talking about Damodara Lila. We're talking about Damodara Lila. Not in this class. It's outside the class. Moraya Soda was boiling the milk on the fire. And when Krishna came and was sucking the breast milk, there was a serious competition that the milk, Moraya Soda's…”

Three more questions, from Zoom and the chat.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:17 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, what we have done first, when we are connected to the scorn like when we have seen someone eating or wearing style which we have seen and because of what we have done so how will we be able to do that? Hare Krishna. Thank you, Mataji. Srila Gurudev, she's asking that…”

children.topic: Q5 · Offences from my early days
children.note:
How can we be free of offences made in our first days in ISKCON, judging how people ate or dressed?

🎙 Maharaj at 98:41 (auto-transcript): “Srila Gurudev, she's asking that in the initial days in ISKCON, we have made offences when it came to seeing people, the way they eat or dress. But those happened in the past. But how can we get rid of those past offences? She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the…”

Repent and pray to the deities for forgiveness: we did not know, now by your mercy we understand; please take this away. A repentant heart is a very powerful purification.

🎙 Maharaj at 98:58 (auto-transcript): “She repents. Repentance. She repents and prays the deities for forgiveness. This we didn't ignore and we don't know Because we don't know all these things We have misbehaved Now, by your mercy, you are letting us understand all these things So we are grateful, we are thankful…”

children.topic: Q6 · Enthusiastic only when you visit?
children.note:
When Maharaj visits India devotees are eager for service, then become lax after he leaves. Is that purification or show?

🎙 Maharaj at 101:25 (auto-transcript): “Shrila Gurudev, she's asking that every time you come for a yatra to India, we are all very enthusiastic, we're all very happy, we're all always up for services. but when as soon as you leave and when we go back home we become laid back but on the other hand even mindfully…”

children.topic: Practise when the teacher is absent
children.note:
It is purification either way; only its quality differs. A good student keeps practising when the teacher is not physically present — that is why the notebook was kept every day, to stay connected rather than living a Sunday-only spirituality. — “You should remain devoted all the time.”

🎙 Maharaj at 102:16 (auto-transcript): “Purification, whether you do it, anyhow, it is purification. The only difference is the quality of the purification is to make the difference. Otherwise, it's purification. So, a good student, So, learn when the spiritual master, the teacher is there, you should learn when…”

What can we do when we feel offensive towards management whose decisions go against us?

🎙 Maharaj at 104:53 (auto-transcript): “he's asking what can we do when we have offensive mindset towards the management when the decisions are not in our favor? It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it…”

The conditioned ego dislikes whatever goes against it. Since we cannot change their decision, do not disturb yourself or offend them; no one took the holy name from you. Advancing, we will see the same things differently. — “Let me do the right thing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 105:07 (auto-transcript): “It is it is the nature of condition shows that anything that doesn't go with our ego, we don't we don't value we don't appreciate it, we don't look at it nice Well, there's something we can do. There's something we can always do at all times. Either the judgment is favorable…”

Maharaj asks who cooked sweet rice for the rasa-lila and whether Krishna's fingers were seen in it; one who only tasted it is told that means Krishna ate it. He thanks everyone for their offering and asks them to continue forever.

🎙 Maharaj at 107:03 (auto-transcript): “and we should do it did you cook your should rise yes how many of us did i sent you a photo you know what what's up how was it tasty did you see christian's hands on it getting soft did you see no i couldn't see oh how was the test taste only okay that means yeah krishna ate…”

nodeData.topic: Session 29 · Gratitude and Transformation Offerings
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The first of two closing sessions is a festival of gratitude: lamps and garlands for Maharaj, the Radhikastakam, and devotees' offerings describing how the series uprooted hidden offences and taught them to beg forgiveness, stay humble and value relationships. A recording of Bhakti Tirtha Swami's 'beggar' meditation is played, the service teams are thanked, and Maharaj closes by thanking everyone and praying that all will see their promotion in Krishna consciousness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
The session opens with every devotee on screen offering a ghee lamp to Maharaj together.

🎙 Maharaj at 00:00 (auto-transcript): “Offer your Ghee Lamps and we request the devotees who came forward and all the devotees as well, please feel welcome. Let's light our Ghee Lamps and offer it. Hare Krishna.”

Devotees who made or bought garlands come forward on screen to offer them for Maharaj's pleasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:40 (auto-transcript): “We would like also to call the devotees who would like to offer you gallons, please. Dear Vishwan Barthar Burjee, Hari Lila Mataji, and Dear Rupashan Mataji, come forward. and all those devotees who would like to join, please bring your own sweet garlands for the pleasure of…”

The garlands are received with appreciation for the beautiful world of devotees and their nice garlands.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:35 (auto-transcript): “Beautiful world. Beautiful. Wonderful people. Very great. Nice garland. Thank you. Nice. Thank you so much, dear beloved devotees for the wonderful garlands. So now, dear devotees, we would like you to invite you to also recitate along while Mataji will recite.”

A devotee sings the Radhikastakam, eight verses glorifying Srimati Radharani, and its translation is read; each verse ends with the prayer to be given the service of her lotus feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 04:28 (auto-transcript): “I would like to kindly call Her Grace Madhuri Manjuri Mataji to please recite the most beautiful Radhikashtakam for all of us. Hare Krishna, dear Gurudev. The prayer is introduced as Krishnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami's, from the Govinda-lilamrta.

children.note:

nodeData.topic: Session 30 · Gratitude, and Going Forward Together
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. In the final session devotees offer lamps, garlands and heartfelt gratitude for the Radha Sunya series, and Maharaj answers each offering with a short teaching. A 'long way to go' has no meaning when Krishna is pleased; a sincere sorry brings peace; a grudge burns the one who holds it; fortune is found only among devotees, who make others fortunate; and every situation, even a problem, can be used to serve Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

The host explains that each lamp stands for the heart the devotee is offering; one garland is offered from Mayapur.

children.topic: Sorry even when not at fault
children.note:
Through Rupa Gosvami's example she learned that if another is offended, one should ask forgiveness even without having made a mistake — this changed her whole philosophy.

Maharaj replies that 'a long way to go' has no meaning in Krishna consciousness: if we please the acharyas, ten million births can become a moment. children.topic: It is me who gets burnt
children.note:
Maharaj adds that we think the other person will pay for our grudge, but whoever holds the fire is burnt — even the one who encouraged us to hold it is not. — “if i'm holding fire it is me who will be burnt”
